invariants.rationale: restoreInstantTimestamp represents the instant to which restore is performed and is expected to be non-null for restore operations.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is the timestamp of the savepoint to be restored and must be non-null for a successful restore.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required for any operation, including restore.
restoreInstantTimestamp should be a valid (non-empty) instant string for the restore operation.
A valid (non-empty) savepointToRestoreTimestamp is required for restore.
